integration: Two generated neutral limb parts, imported with the existing Unity cyan-key/whole-component importer. Original torso/face/weapon pixels come from 0.7 rifle movement frames 0 and 4. Runtime meshes preserve texture UVs and articulate independent near/far legs using an authored two-bone solver. No original raster overwritten.
limitations: Same neutral outer-leg texture reused for near/far legs, with far-leg shading.
Layered 2D rig rather than captured human motion.
Source camo and equipment remain illustrative.
Only military rifle locomotion uses the rig; civilian and military unarmed locomotion remain unfinished.
